items.q: thought I was going to make a million dollars or something teaching Tiger Flowers how to tap dance, you know.

ctx.x: And he must have liked my color or something, you know. I was full of sunshine, tan, you see, I want to tell you -- (inaudible) so he said -- he says, "How about you?" you know. I was kind of serious at that time. I didn't -- I didn't laugh a lot myself but I was full of happiness, you understand. So he say, "Would you like to teach me? You know?"

So I look at Boby, you know, and my cousin Boby started shoving my shoulder (inaudible) that's Tiger Flowers (inaudible), thought I was going to make a million dollars or something teaching Tiger Flowers how to tap dance, you know. So really my idea was to teach myself along with teaching him, you see, because he says, how he was going to pay. "You teach me and I'll teach you, you know.
